t: A free spreadsheet style statistics program built on R that runs offline or in a browser.
steps: Go to the jamovi site and download the desktop app, or open the Cloud version in a browser.
Ask IT to approve the installer for the desktop app.
Open a sample data file and look at the spreadsheet.
Run one descriptive analysis from the menu.
Try a graph and a simple test.
Use the desktop app for any lesson with student data.
Save student files on the computer and not in Cloud.
